After the competition ended, the FIG confirmed that Yang Tae Young's start value on PB should have been 10 (the routine was scored from a 9.9).  Had Yang's routine been given the correct start value, he would have finished ahead of Paul Hamm by 0.051 points.  But, according to FIG rules, results cannot be changed after a competition has ended.  The FIG asked Hamm to give his gold medal to Yang; Hamm refused.  Yang has appealed to the Court of Arbitration and Sport.
